integrity: A complete self-contained elementary proof with exact attained witnesses and a standalone rational checker; finite tests corroborate rather than certify arbitrary dimension. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite real paths, positive edge weights and truncated three-point windows; no classification for other stencils, general graphs, or cyclic boundary weights. Historical priority is conditional on the inspected published material and may be affected by inaccessible older sources. A 1993 midrange paper has an earlier year-only date, not a verified earliest release day.
title: Sharp weighted-variation stability and boundary-weight rigidity of the three-point midrange filter
